A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SketchDeco study, with 17 readable pages covering the main paper, references and appendices F–M. Text, equations, tables and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original global and local sketch-colourisation experiments, quantitative benchmarks in Tables 1–3, and qualitative and ablation results throughout the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original quantitative benchmarks, qualitative evaluations and ablation results, including the supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3.3 changes the specified mask-composition operation from M_tot = max(sum_i M^(i), 1) to M_tot = max_i M^(i). The remaining generation, inversion and attention pipeline is unchanged. This establishes a correction to the written procedure, not an implementation change or experimental rerun.

E1.justification: Both retain AFHQ-cat/dog, Place365 indoor/outdoor scenes, Danbooru2023, PascalVOC2012 and in-the-wild sketches, with the same global and local colourisation tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–2 and the appendix comparisons. This includes ColorizeDiffusion, ColorFlow, MangaNinja and Cobra locally; DiffBlender and T2I-Adapter variants globally; and the supplementary SDEdit, ControlNet and DiSS comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported sample counts, splits, sketch preprocessing, two-mask evaluation, palette size, backbone configurations and five evaluation metrics are unchanged. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The palette-size, prompt, attention-injection, scaling-factor, inversion and component-choice analyses in Section 4.3 and appendices G–J are retained. Figure S9 changes image resolution without adding or revising an analytical comparison.

E5.justification: Seed-related descriptions and statistical reporting are unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results in Tables 1–3 and Appendix J are unchanged, as are the reported qualitative findings. The four altered image assets in Figure S9 depict the same outputs at different raster resolutions, rather than new result entries.

T1.justification: The total-mask definition in Section 3.3 receives a substantive mathematical correction. The v2 expression forces M_tot to be at least one even outside selected regions; v3 uses the pointwise maximum of masks, giving their union for binary masks and preserving uncovered background. Other equations and formal reasoning are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, conclusion and Appendix K retain the same claims about training-free region control, latent composition, colour fidelity, global harmony and efficient generation in approximately 15–20 steps.

C2.justification: The interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Appendix L retains the same limitations concerning colour fidelity in small regions and compatibility with the CSS3 colour-name vocabulary.

D1.justification: v2 provides a direct SketchDeco project-page link on its title page; v3 removes it without a replacement elsewhere. Implementation details and hyperparameters remain unchanged. This reduces access information but does not establish that the external resource became unavailable.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty positioning and all 91 numbered references are retained. Bibliography entries shift between pages because acknowledgements were inserted, rather than because cited works changed.

P1.justification: The author list changes from six authors to Chaitat Utintu and Yi-Zhe Song, with corresponding affiliation and contact edits. v3 adds funding acknowledgements and an open-access statement. The scientific narrative and section order remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure S9 changes the raster resolution of four existing final-result panels: fish, sailboat and backpack images have higher resolution, while the shirt image has lower resolution. Their content and arrangement are retained. The title block and reference pages also reflow.

improvement.justification: The corrected mask definition in Section 3.3 fixes the written background-composition rule, improving technical correctness and reproducibility. Some Figure S9 panels are clearer, although removing the direct project link reduces resource discoverability. The experimental evidence and core claims remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
